name: 33141 · Miami Beach, FL
findings: ZIP 33141 (Miami Beach) has 102 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33141 (Miami Beach) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33141 (Miami Beach) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).
